page.overview:
Who is Goldberg?

Goldberg is a giant from Elbaph who is the cook of the New Giant Warrior Pirates and was formerly an S-Class ranked mercenary for Buggy's Delivery.

He is a major ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Elbaph Arc.

Goldberg is a very rotund giant with dark orange hair and a wide mouth. He wears green plaid suspenders with dark stripes, a grey cape with a flower buckle, and a viking helmet, and lacks a shirt. He also wears a belt across his chest.

As a newborn, he had shorter light brown hair and was wrapped in a yellow cloth in the anime.
